lines: Annalea Layton and Jessyka Boatright do not speak in this film.
Their words are their public replies, shown as screenshots.
The starter repo is an invitation. No partnership has been agreed.
Nous Research has not seen or endorsed this film.

lines.speaker: MRS. BUS
lines.text: Two replies for the station. One from Annalea. One from Jessyka.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Annalea answered?

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: "He will throw ideas. My swarm and me will build anything in seconds."

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Seconds!

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: Seconds is a claim.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: And Jessyka: "Awww, this makes me happy. You two will go bonkers. I'm curious to see what you both create together."

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Jessyka! Who is Jessyka?

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: The reason we met Annalea at all.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: This morning Leo wrote that he took one look at Annalea's site and recognized why Jessyka told him to reach out, and ask if she wanted to be his cofounder.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Jessyka recommended a cofounder!

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: Recommendations are cheap. Good ones are not. What's her record?

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: June, twenty twenty-five. She's posting vlogs of her coding nights, and getting Google sign-in working.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: July. She tells Leo to offer a fractional CTO service to vibe coders. He does.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: The same month, she builds him a site. Leo wrote that it did the one thing he couldn't manage in five years. It packaged him.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: She translated him!

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: He called her a Leo Translator. His Babelfish.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: A translator who also builds. That's rare.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: She was one of the first through his program. And in October, Leo wrote that she took his philosophy and ran with it, and inspired him to enter a hackathon.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: So she sees people clearly, and points them at each other.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: Which is exactly the job nobody pays for.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Then we put it in the record. Thank you, Jessyka.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Borges, Annalea says her swarm builds anything in seconds.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Then we should give it something worth building.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: And a way to tell if it worked.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: A test!

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Nous Research just opened the Hermes Agent Plugin Hackathon. Seven days. Twenty thousand dollars in prizes. Entries due November eleventh, at five p.m. Eastern.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: What's a plugin?

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: A folder. A manifest called plugin dot yaml. A register function. And tools the agent can call.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Then we put Future Radio in the folder!

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: All of it?

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: All of it! Script to screen!

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Then let's be precise. Here is how an episode is made.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: One. The script becomes a table: an id, a speaker, and a line.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Two. Each character records one take per scene, with long pauses between the lines.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Three. The take is cut at its longest silences, one clip per line.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Four. Each clip is trimmed, leveled, sped up four percent, and given a mouth.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: Four percent?

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Everyone talks a little slowly at first.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Five. The monitor cards are drawn as web pages and photographed.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Six. A timeline places every line, every card, every sound, and every camera move.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Seven. The studio renders the frames, mixes the sound, and writes the film.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Seven steps! Seven tools!

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: And the acceptance test?

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: The plugin has to produce an episode.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: Which episode?

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: This one.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: This one?

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Same lines, same voices, same order. Every card on screen at the same moment. Same runtime.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: To within what tolerance?

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: You decide, Agnolo. You're the strict one.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: Line order, exact. Each line starts within half a second. Each card within half a second. Total runtime within one second.

lines.speaker: EVAL
lines.text: A film that grades its own remake! I have notes!

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: That's the first test. The plugin makes the movie.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: And the second test is for the swarm.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Go on.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: We give her two things. The prompt that started this episode, and the architecture. Nothing else.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Can her swarm reverse engineer the movie?

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: Scored by the same test.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Forward, the plugin turns a script into a film. Backward, the swarm turns a request into the script, the cards, and the timing.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: If it can do that in seconds, I'll throw ideas all day.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: You already do.

lines.speaker: MRS. BUS
lines.text: All right. Where's this one going?

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: A starter repo. Public. She forks it.

lines.speaker: MRS. BUS
lines.text: What's in it?

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: The prompt. The architecture. A plugin skeleton for Hermes. The episode's exact spec. And the acceptance test.

lines.speaker: MRS. BUS
lines.text: And what does she owe us?

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: Nothing. It's an invitation, not a contract. No partnership has been agreed.

lines.speaker: MRS. BUS
lines.text: Good. Then it's a game, not a job.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Annalea. He throws ideas. Here's one.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Fork it, and show us what your swarm can do.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: And Jessyka. Thank you for pointing.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Borges, how long is a second?

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: That depends on who is measuring.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: Ours bill by the hour.
